title: 第1287章 雷火同源第1286章 星域虫潮
slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
“坏我虫族大计，至尊也保不了你，杀了他们！”
六位虫皇联手围猎。
空间虫皇破坏此方星空场域，铺天盖地的虫族兵虫悍不畏死，将三人重重包围，发起进攻。
“嗡嗡嗡——”
兵虫嘶鸣声交织成滚滚浪潮，有虫皇施展神通，那些向白泽他们发起冲锋的兵虫身体冒出诡异红光，凶性更重。
星空当中，又有成千上万只虫族复眼出现，迸射出灰蓝光线，向三人绞杀而来。
“此地场域已经被破坏，先杀出去再说！”野狗道人周身冒出雷火，霎时间将围剿而来的虫潮清扫一空！
雷火同源。
白泽深吸一口气，身后有巨大火莲层层绽放，红莲业火焚烧星空，硬生生烧出一条通途。
人魔更是简单干脆，一拳递出，碎星魔冲打烂虚空，湮灭不知多少虫族！
三人神通各显，那星域虫潮压根挡不住三人攻势。可虫族六大族群倾巢而出，过河卒数量何止千万，这边刚杀完一片，立刻就有密密麻麻的兵虫扑杀过来，填补空缺。
“虫族惯用手段打消耗，还得提防那几个虫皇，膈噫蛋！”野狗道人雷火并出，打碎绞杀而来的灰蓝光线，“葬爱老弟，尊者，各自为战不是办法，迟早被拖死，还是联手先杀出去再说！”
“本尊挡住虫皇，你保那小子，他来开道！”人魔吼道。
“我没意见。”白泽回应道。
“那就干吧！”野狗道人神色狰狞，“狗爷我还不想被虫豸吃掉！”
“拦住他们！”
虫族三位虫皇直接下场，空间虫皇施展神通，将它们直接送到了三人附近！
那些兵虫一时间更加疯狂，不计代价地阻挠三人会合。
人魔祭炼一尊石塔，只见那巴掌大的石塔甫一被祭出，巅峰仙器的威压顿时打穿星空，释放出恐怖杀力！
“顶级仙宝！”

“好恐怖的杀力！”
虫族三大虫皇眼见那尊石塔迎风就长，即便塔身多处破损，还有如此神威，立刻意识到不妙。
“镇杀！”
人魔火力全开，顶级仙器甫一出手，便击杀一只虫皇，将所有拦路兵虫尽数剿灭。
三人顺利会合。
野狗道人眼睛都直了，说道：“尊者，有这宝贝不直接干翻它们？”
说归说，可他也看得出来，这尊神秘石塔对人魔的消耗极大。
破损至此都有顶级仙器的杀力，若是完整无缺，那不得逆天了？
白泽神色凛然。
他的情况说到底也不比人魔好。
此身为剑，剑即此身。别的剑仙是一人一剑，如鱼得水，他是器灵耍本体，俩半个拼凑出一个完整的一。
如此局势，着实不妙。
那道人释放剑域，杀出一条通道。三人联手，一时间虫族竟拿他们没办法。空间虫皇嘶鸣一声，三眼女蛾尾部轻颤，吐出千丝缚道网，其上沾满毒液，比之先前在帝路尽头被白泽刀斩的那只，更加刁钻。
空间虫皇发力，一道道虚空漩涡向三人砸来，企图将白泽他们放逐开来，避免他们联手杀出包围。
另外几只虫皇也纷纷祭炼神通，一时间星空深处乱作一团。
“艹了，没完没了！”野狗道人神色狰狞，硬抗虫皇一击，人魔拳开虚空漩涡，白泽业已将那拦路千丝缚道网烧成灰烬。
content_en:
"If you mess up our Zerg plan, even the Supreme Being can't protect you, kill them!"
Six insect kings teamed up to hunt.
The Space Insect King destroyed the starry sky here, and the overwhelming Insect soldiers were not afraid of death. They surrounded the three of them and launched an attack.
"Buzz buzz-"
The screams of the soldiers and insects intertwined into a rolling wave. The insect king used his magical power. The bodies of the soldiers and insects that charged towards Bai Ze and the others emitted a strange red light and became more ferocious.
In the starry sky, thousands more Zerg compound eyes appeared, shooting out gray-blue light and strangling the three of them.
"The field here has been destroyed, let's kill it first!" Thunder fire erupted from Taoist Wild Dog's body, and he wiped out the encircling insect tide in an instant!
Thunder and fire come from the same source.
Bai Ze took a deep breath, and huge fire lotuses bloomed behind him. The red lotus karma fire burned the starry sky, forcibly burning a path.
The Human Demon was even more simple and straightforward. With one punch, the Star Breaker Demon rushed into the void and annihilated countless Zerg races!
The three of them showed their magical powers, but the star field insect swarm could not stop the attack of the three of them. But the six major groups of the Zerg race came out in full force, and the number of soldiers crossing the river exceeded tens of millions. As soon as one area was killed here, dense soldiers and insects immediately came to fill the gap.
"The Zerg tribe is accustomed to using methods to defeat the enemy, but you have to be careful of those insect kings, you know?" Wild Dog Taoist came out with thunder and fire, shattering the grey-blue light coming from the strangulation, "My dear brother, venerable, fighting alone is not an option. Sooner or later, we will be dragged to death, so we should join forces to kill them out first!"
"I am blocking the Insect King. You protect that boy and he will clear the way!" the human demon roared.
"I have no objection." Bai Ze responded.
"Then do it!" Taoist Wild Dog looked ferocious, "Master Dog, I don't want to be eaten by insects yet!"
"Stop them!"
The three insect kings of the Zerg clan left the field directly. The space insect king used his magical power to send them directly to the vicinity of the three of them!
Those soldiers became even crazier for a while, trying to prevent the three of them from reuniting at any cost.
The human demon sacrificed a stone tower, and as soon as the palm-sized stone tower was sacrificed, the pressure of the peak immortal weapon immediately penetrated the starry sky, releasing terrifying killing power!
"Top Immortal Treasure!"
"What a terrifying killing force!"
The three insect kings of the Zerg tribe saw that the stone tower grew in the wind. Even though the tower body was damaged in many places, it still had such power, and they immediately realized that something was wrong.
"Suppress and kill!"
The human and demon were at full firepower, and as soon as the top-level immortal weapon was launched, it killed an insect king and wiped out all the insects blocking the way.
The three of them met successfully.
Taoist Wild Dog's eyes widened and he said, "Sir, if you have this treasure, why don't you just kill them?"
After all, he could also see that this mysterious stone tower was extremely draining on humans and demons.
Even if it is damaged to this point, it has the killing power of a top-level immortal weapon. If it is intact, how can it be against the heavens?
Bai Ze looked solemn.
In the final analysis, his situation is no better than that of a human demon.
This body is the sword, and the sword is this body. Other sword immortals have one person and one sword, and they are like a fish in water. He is a weapon spirit playing with the body, and the two halves piece together a complete one.
This situation is really not good.
The Taoist released his sword domain and opened a passage. The three of them joined forces, and for a while the Zerg were unable to do anything to them. The Space Insect King hissed, the tail of the three-eyed female moth trembled slightly, and she spit out a thousand-wire Dao Binding Net, which was covered with venom. It was even more cunning than the one that was killed by Bai Ze's sword at the end of the Imperial Road.
The Space Insect King exerted his strength, and a series of void whirlpools came towards the three of them, trying to drive Bai Ze and the others away to prevent them from joining forces to break out of the siege.
Several other insect kings also practiced their magical powers, and for a while there was chaos in the depths of the starry sky.
"Fuck you, there will be no end!" Taoist Wild Dog looked ferocious as he resisted the Insect King's blow. The human-demon fist opened a vortex in the void, and Bai Zeye had burned the thousand-wire Dao-binding net blocking the road to ashes.
